name: How do I know when it is time to repaint my kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How do I know when it is time to repaint my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repainting is recommended if you notice peeling paint around the stove, dark water rings near the sink, persistent grease stains that wipe-downs cannot remove, or a dated color scheme that clashes with new appliances. High heat and humidity from daily cooking degrade wall coatings faster in kitchens than in living spaces or bedrooms. If your paint feels tacky to the touch or shows flaking along the trim, the protective seal has failed and a fresh, properly primed paint job is needed to protect the drywall underneath.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repaint when you notice peeling near appliances, persistent cooking stains, sticky surfaces, faded trim, or when updating colors to match new counters or appliances.
